posts.text: Congratulations to the new NITI Aayog appointees. India's growth story is built on vision and teamwork. As I told my good friend President Trump, the India-US partnership has never been stronger. Together we will achieve great things for both nations.
posts.caption: Congratulations to the new NITI Aayog appointees. India's growth story is built on vision and teamwork. As I told my good friend President Trump, the India-US partnership has never been stronger. Together we will achieve great things for both nations.

posts.text: PM Modi paid heartfelt tributes on Buddha Purnima and extended warm wishes on Maharashtra Day. The government remains committed to the welfare of every citizen and continues working tirelessly for a developed India.
posts.caption: PM Modi paid heartfelt tributes on Buddha Purnima and extended warm wishes on Maharashtra Day. The government remains committed to the welfare of every citizen and continues working tirelessly for a developed India.

posts.text: One who is toiling should get the profit. I met Bharat Taxi drivers today — hardworking people who deserve dignity and opportunity. This government stands firmly with the workers and entrepreneurs of India.
posts.caption: One who is toiling should get the profit. I met Bharat Taxi drivers today — hardworking people who deserve dignity and opportunity. This government stands firmly with the workers and entrepreneurs of India.

posts.text: India's interests have been compromised in dealings with the US. The budget fails to address the real concerns of working families. We will continue to hold this government accountable for every promise made to the people.
posts.caption: India's interests have been compromised in dealings with the US. The budget fails to address the real concerns of working families. We will continue to hold this government accountable for every promise made to the people.

posts.text: We are recruiting 1 lakh youth into UP police to strengthen law and order. Under our government, 6.5 lakh jobs have been created. Uttar Pradesh is transforming into a powerhouse of growth and opportunity.
posts.caption: We are recruiting 1 lakh youth into UP police to strengthen law and order. Under our government, 6.5 lakh jobs have been created. Uttar Pradesh is transforming into a powerhouse of growth and opportunity.

posts.text: The people of Delhi deserve honest governance and world-class public services. Our work on education and healthcare speaks for itself. We will continue to fight for the common citizen's rights and dignity.
posts.caption: The people of Delhi deserve honest governance and world-class public services. Our work on education and healthcare speaks for itself. We will continue to fight for the common citizen's rights and dignity.

posts.text: We will never give in to nuclear blackmail. India's foreign policy is rooted in strength and sovereignty. Our relationship with the US is deepening across defence, technology and trade — built on mutual respect, not submission.
posts.caption: We will never give in to nuclear blackmail. India's foreign policy is rooted in strength and sovereignty. Our relationship with the US is deepening across defence, technology and trade — built on mutual respect, not submission.

posts.text: India's economy continues on a robust growth trajectory. Our fiscal discipline and strategic investments are paying dividends. We remain focused on inclusive growth that uplifts every section of society.
posts.caption: India's economy continues on a robust growth trajectory. Our fiscal discipline and strategic investments are paying dividends. We remain focused on inclusive growth that uplifts every section of society.

posts.text: Even in the face of fierce headwinds, we have never retreated. Instead, we have recalibrated. The Adani Group's commitment to nation-building through infrastructure and energy remains unwavering. Growth demands resilience.
posts.caption: Even in the face of fierce headwinds, we have never retreated. Instead, we have recalibrated. The Adani Group's commitment to nation-building through infrastructure and energy remains unwavering. Growth demands resilience.

posts.text: I am proud to contribute Rs 151 crore to the Indian Council of Technology. India's digital transformation is the most exciting opportunity of our generation. Reliance will continue investing in the future of this great nation.
posts.caption: I am proud to contribute Rs 151 crore to the Indian Council of Technology. India's digital transformation is the most exciting opportunity of our generation. Reliance will continue investing in the future of this great nation.

posts.text: I have always believed that the true measure of a nation's progress lies in how it uplifts its most vulnerable. The Tata legacy is one of trust, integrity and purpose — values that will endure long beyond any one individual.
posts.caption: I have always believed that the true measure of a nation's progress lies in how it uplifts its most vulnerable. The Tata legacy is one of trust, integrity and purpose — values that will endure long beyond any one individual.

posts.text: On the occasion of Buddha Purnima, I extend my greetings to all. Lord Buddha's message of peace, compassion and harmony is more relevant today than ever. India stands as a beacon of democratic values for the world.
posts.caption: On the occasion of Buddha Purnima, I extend my greetings to all. Lord Buddha's message of peace, compassion and harmony is more relevant today than ever. India stands as a beacon of democratic values for the world.

posts.text: Yesterday, in a meaningless vote, the House voted to limit my War Powers. I am an innocent man who has been horribly treated. Meanwhile, I called Netanyahu — he's crazy, but we'll get the deal done. America First, always!
posts.caption: Yesterday, in a meaningless vote, the House voted to limit my War Powers. I am an innocent man who has been horribly treated. Meanwhile, I called Netanyahu — he's crazy, but we'll get the deal done. America First, always!

posts.text: There is enormous optimism and trust in India. We must close the global AI confidence gap by building frameworks that work for democracies. I'm proud of the achievements during my time in office — Britain is stronger for it.
posts.caption: There is enormous optimism and trust in India. We must close the global AI confidence gap by building frameworks that work for democracies. I'm proud of the achievements during my time in office — Britain is stronger for it.

posts.text: I am honoured to announce that I am running to be the next Governor of Ohio. President Trump has given his full endorsement. After serving at DOGE, I'm ready to bring that same energy to transform my home state.
posts.caption: I am honoured to announce that I am running to be the next Governor of Ohio. President Trump has given his full endorsement. After serving at DOGE, I'm ready to bring that same energy to transform my home state.

posts.text: I'm thrilled to bring back my Summer Reading Challenge for another year! The challenge will help kids fall in love with reading outside the classroom. Over 20,000 children participated last year across all 50 states.
posts.caption: I'm thrilled to bring back my Summer Reading Challenge for another year! The challenge will help kids fall in love with reading outside the classroom. Over 20,000 children participated last year across all 50 states.

posts.text: Today's takedown of multiple healthcare companies is the latest victory in the Trump administration's total war on fraudsters. We launched the Most Wanted Fraudsters list — Operation Summer Heat 2.0 is just getting started.
posts.caption: Today's takedown of multiple healthcare companies is the latest victory in the Trump administration's total war on fraudsters. We launched the Most Wanted Fraudsters list — Operation Summer Heat 2.0 is just getting started.

posts.text: India can leverage US innovation to build AI tools for its citizens. All the leading model companies are based in the US. Our pitch to every country is simple: we want to be the best partner when it comes to AI.
posts.caption: India can leverage US innovation to build AI tools for its citizens. All the leading model companies are based in the US. Our pitch to every country is simple: we want to be the best partner when it comes to AI.

posts.text: The World Bank could mobilize $80 to $100 billion for countries hit by war. This is not a one-size-fits-all approach. Small states are diverse, and our support will reflect that. We also know the economics are different.
posts.caption: The World Bank could mobilize $80 to $100 billion for countries hit by war. This is not a one-size-fits-all approach. Small states are diverse, and our support will reflect that. We also know the economics are different.

posts.text: Musk has been interfering in our politics again, trying to whip up division. That is not who we are in Britain. We are focused on delivering for working people — strengthening defence, growing the economy, and protecting our values.
posts.caption: Musk has been interfering in our politics again, trying to whip up division. That is not who we are in Britain. We are focused on delivering for working people — strengthening defence, growing the economy, and protecting our values.

posts.text: The French Navy successfully boarded a Russian shadow fleet tanker. France has drafted a UN Security Council resolution on the Strait of Hormuz. We are deploying nuclear-capable aircraft to support our European allies. Sovereignty demands action.
posts.caption: The French Navy successfully boarded a Russian shadow fleet tanker. France has drafted a UN Security Council resolution on the Strait of Hormuz. We are deploying nuclear-capable aircraft to support our European allies. Sovereignty demands action.

posts.text: Passed the House: tax cuts for every worker and a fair go for first home buyers. Australia has robust, comprehensive, and world-leading legislation addressing forced labour. We stand firm against unjustified US tariffs.
posts.caption: Passed the House: tax cuts for every worker and a fair go for first home buyers. Australia has robust, comprehensive, and world-leading legislation addressing forced labour. We stand firm against unjustified US tariffs.

posts.text: Today we took decisions to accelerate the UAE's industrial growth. We are launching an AED 1 billion fund to strengthen resilience, expand local production, and scale artificial intelligence. Our target is clear: fully localise more than 5,000 critical products.
posts.caption: Today we took decisions to accelerate the UAE's industrial growth. We are launching an AED 1 billion fund to strengthen resilience, expand local production, and scale artificial intelligence. Our target is clear: fully localise more than 5,000 critical products.

posts.text: The West has created an utterly evil state religion where an accusation of 'racism' is the gravest offense. Free speech is the bedrock of civilization. X remains the platform where truth can be spoken without fear.
posts.caption: The West has created an utterly evil state religion where an accusation of 'racism' is the gravest offense. Free speech is the bedrock of civilization. X remains the platform where truth can be spoken without fear.

posts.text: We just launched Meta Business Agent — an AI that will eventually help you run your whole business. We're seeing a massive increase in entrepreneurship powered by AI. Meta is investing $125 to $145 billion in capex to make this real.
posts.caption: We just launched Meta Business Agent — an AI that will eventually help you run your whole business. We're seeing a massive increase in entrepreneurship powered by AI. Meta is investing $125 to $145 billion in capex to make this real.

posts.text: AI is the most profound platform shift of our lifetimes. Alphabet announced an $80 billion equity raise to accelerate our AI infrastructure. We've rolled out AI Mode in India Search — bringing the power of AI to over a billion users.
posts.caption: AI is the most profound platform shift of our lifetimes. Alphabet announced an $80 billion equity raise to accelerate our AI infrastructure. We've rolled out AI Mode in India Search — bringing the power of AI to over a billion users.

posts.text: What you just saw at Build 2026 is a pretty significant shift — AI agents are replacing apps and even the OS itself. This is absolutely a non-goal! We are investing $3 billion in India because we believe in its extraordinary potential.
posts.caption: What you just saw at Build 2026 is a pretty significant shift — AI agents are replacing apps and even the OS itself. This is absolutely a non-goal! We are investing $3 billion in India because we believe in its extraordinary potential.

posts.text: I'm urging Congress not to require AI model approvals before deployment — it would stifle American innovation. Our heaviest user went from 100K to 100 billion tokens per month. We just shipped Codex, and usage is exploding.
posts.caption: I'm urging Congress not to require AI model approvals before deployment — it would stifle American innovation. Our heaviest user went from 100K to 100 billion tokens per month. We just shipped Codex, and usage is exploding.

posts.text: I am healthy. My energy is high, and I plan to be in this role for as long as the board and I agree it makes sense. I will transition to Executive Chairman on September 1. WWDC 2026 on June 8 will show where Apple is headed next.
posts.caption: I am healthy. My energy is high, and I plan to be in this role for as long as the board and I agree it makes sense. I will transition to Executive Chairman on September 1. WWDC 2026 on June 8 will show where Apple is headed next.

posts.text: Did I bring any gifts for Korea? I brought a lot of business for Korea! Robotics is the next major sector — a multi-trillion dollar market. I told my friends at Marvell they could be the next trillion-dollar company. The future is accelerated computing.
posts.caption: Did I bring any gifts for Korea? I brought a lot of business for Korea! Robotics is the next major sector — a multi-trillion dollar market. I told my friends at Marvell they could be the next trillion-dollar company. The future is accelerated computing.

posts.text: We are in a golden age of Alzheimer's research. Commonwealth Fusion's validation is a breakthrough for clean energy. Those who have the most should be pushed to be more generous — a wealth tax is a conversation we need to have.
posts.caption: We are in a golden age of Alzheimer's research. Commonwealth Fusion's validation is a breakthrough for clean energy. Those who have the most should be pushed to be more generous — a wealth tax is a conversation we need to have.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker — is a model for the world. AI will be the next layer of this stack. We must ensure it remains open, inclusive, and built for a billion people.
posts.caption: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker — is a model for the world. AI will be the next layer of this stack. We must ensure it remains open, inclusive, and built for a billion people.

posts.text: The quantum era is no longer ahead of us — it has started. IBM is investing more than $10 billion in quantum computing over the next five years. The pace of discovery with quantum computers is accelerating rapidly.
posts.caption: The quantum era is no longer ahead of us — it has started. IBM is investing more than $10 billion in quantum computing over the next five years. The pace of discovery with quantum computers is accelerating rapidly.

posts.text: The next era of creativity is being written right now — shaped by AI, by new workflows and by entirely new forms of expression. Adobe has never waited for the future to arrive. We've anticipated it. We've built it. And we've led it.
posts.caption: The next era of creativity is being written right now — shaped by AI, by new workflows and by entirely new forms of expression. Adobe has never waited for the future to arrive. We've anticipated it. We've built it. And we've led it.

posts.text: We believe AIs will use the web a thousand times, a million times, more than humans ever have. At Parallel, we just launched Index — a platform for content creators to receive fair compensation when AI uses their work.
posts.caption: We believe AIs will use the web a thousand times, a million times, more than humans ever have. At Parallel, we just launched Index — a platform for content creators to receive fair compensation when AI uses their work.

posts.text: AI is going to be transformative in our world, and luxury has to engage with it. But I keep a relentless focus on human creation — AI must support human creators, not replace them. At Chanel, we are high on ethics and integrity.
posts.caption: AI is going to be transformative in our world, and luxury has to engage with it. But I keep a relentless focus on human creation — AI must support human creators, not replace them. At Chanel, we are high on ethics and integrity.

posts.text: FedEx is now entering a new era as we build the most flexible, efficient, and intelligent network in history. Our vision is simple: to make supply chains smarter for everyone. Digital intelligence is a true force multiplier.
posts.caption: FedEx is now entering a new era as we build the most flexible, efficient, and intelligent network in history. Our vision is simple: to make supply chains smarter for everyone. Digital intelligence is a true force multiplier.

posts.text: Sitting in my position, I cannot use words like struggle and sacrifice. RCB winning back-to-back titles is for the fans who never stopped believing. The journey continues — there's always more to achieve, more to give.
posts.caption: Sitting in my position, I cannot use words like struggle and sacrifice. RCB winning back-to-back titles is for the fans who never stopped believing. The journey continues — there's always more to achieve, more to give.

posts.text: I need to sit with the BCCI secretary and discuss the new guidelines. The hamstring has been a setback but I'm working hard on recovery. The team comes first, and I'll be ready when India needs me.
posts.caption: I need to sit with the BCCI secretary and discuss the new guidelines. The hamstring has been a setback but I'm working hard on recovery. The team comes first, and I'll be ready when India needs me.

posts.text: Currently I don't know if I'm playing the next game or not. I take it one match at a time with CSK. The fans, the franchise, the teammates — that's what keeps me going. Cricket has given me everything.
posts.caption: Currently I don't know if I'm playing the next game or not. I take it one match at a time with CSK. The fans, the franchise, the teammates — that's what keeps me going. Cricket has given me everything.

posts.text: I carried a slight niggle coming back from the T20 World Cup. The body needs rest and recovery at the right times. My focus is on being fully fit for India's biggest tournaments ahead.
posts.caption: I carried a slight niggle coming back from the T20 World Cup. The body needs rest and recovery at the right times. My focus is on being fully fit for India's biggest tournaments ahead.

posts.text: As an all-rounder, my job is to make an impact with both bat and ball every game. Mumbai Indians is home, and I'm committed to giving everything for this franchise. The World Cup preparation is always on my mind.
posts.caption: As an all-rounder, my job is to make an impact with both bat and ball every game. Mumbai Indians is home, and I'm committed to giving everything for this franchise. The World Cup preparation is always on my mind.

posts.text: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi had an influence on games that went beyond the runs he scored. Oppositions were thinking about him before he arrived at the crease. I would give him the freedom to bat the way he does — he is India's future.
posts.caption: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi had an influence on games that went beyond the runs he scored. Oppositions were thinking about him before he arrived at the crease. I would give him the freedom to bat the way he does — he is India's future.

posts.text: In T20s, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi should be included right away, but not in Test cricket. He has to score more runs in first-class cricket. At the moment he's just too talented — to see a 15-year-old bat like this is phenomenal. He is India's future.
posts.caption: In T20s, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi should be included right away, but not in Test cricket. He has to score more runs in first-class cricket. At the moment he's just too talented — to see a 15-year-old bat like this is phenomenal. He is India's future.

posts.text: The IPL 2026 season has been a resounding success. We congratulate RCB on their back-to-back championship. Indian cricket continues to set global benchmarks. T20 World Cup 2026 preparations are in full swing.
posts.caption: The IPL 2026 season has been a resounding success. We congratulate RCB on their back-to-back championship. Indian cricket continues to set global benchmarks. T20 World Cup 2026 preparations are in full swing.

posts.text: T20 World Cup 2026 is here! India has been placed in Group A alongside USA, Namibia, Netherlands and Pakistan. The biggest stars in cricket are ready for the ultimate showdown. Let the games begin!
posts.caption: T20 World Cup 2026 is here! India has been placed in Group A alongside USA, Namibia, Netherlands and Pakistan. The biggest stars in cricket are ready for the ultimate showdown. Let the games begin!

posts.text: What a season! IPL 2026 delivered unforgettable moments — from Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking 776 runs to RCB's dominant back-to-back title run. Thank you to every fan who made this the greatest IPL ever.
posts.caption: What a season! IPL 2026 delivered unforgettable moments — from Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking 776 runs to RCB's dominant back-to-back title run. Thank you to every fan who made this the greatest IPL ever.

posts.text: We are proud of our Brave Indian Armed Forces. Jai Hind, Jai Bharat, Jai Army! Won the Ostrava Golden Spike with a throw of 85.29 metres. The preparation for the big events continues — always pushing for more.
posts.caption: We are proud of our Brave Indian Armed Forces. Jai Hind, Jai Bharat, Jai Army! Won the Ostrava Golden Spike with a throw of 85.29 metres. The preparation for the big events continues — always pushing for more.

posts.text: Norway Chess 2026 has been a tough tournament with losses to Praggnanandhaa and Firouzja. But every defeat teaches you something. As world champion, I know the target on my back is bigger — that only motivates me to work harder.
posts.caption: Norway Chess 2026 has been a tough tournament with losses to Praggnanandhaa and Firouzja. But every defeat teaches you something. As world champion, I know the target on my back is bigger — that only motivates me to work harder.

posts.text: I'm back in the BWF world top 10 after 954 days! It feels incredible after the injury struggles and form challenges. Back-to-back quarterfinals at Thailand Open and Singapore Open gave me the confidence. The best is yet to come.
posts.caption: I'm back in the BWF world top 10 after 954 days! It feels incredible after the injury struggles and form challenges. Back-to-back quarterfinals at Thailand Open and Singapore Open gave me the confidence. The best is yet to come.

posts.text: Rohan was my first-ever mixed doubles partner at age 14 and we won the nationals. 22 years later, finishing my Grand Slam career alongside him at the Australian Open was truly special. Tennis gave me everything.
posts.caption: Rohan was my first-ever mixed doubles partner at age 14 and we won the nationals. 22 years later, finishing my Grand Slam career alongside him at the Australian Open was truly special. Tennis gave me everything.

posts.text: Indian football is growing and Bengaluru FC continues to fight in every match. The young players coming through give me so much hope. My goal has always been to inspire the next generation to dream bigger for Indian football.
